text:
Maria (Support): @Tenant-ops ACME reported a sudden spike in 429s and token latency on their dedicated pool starting ~09:12 UTC. They say requests got routed to a small rack (rack-7b) instead of their gold-dedicated pool. CTX: tenant=acme-prod, model=gptx-1.
Priya (Customer Success): they opened a ticket (ACME-4489). impact: user-facing errors and queueing. Customer says rate unchanged.
Tenant-ops (ACME): confirmed — traffic rate steady, but backend shows requests hitting pool-id=p-rack-7b (capacity 2 GPUs) not p-gold-acme (capacity 16).
Maria (Support): attaching request header sample: `X-Redwood-Tier: gold, X-Tenant: acme-prod, X-Route-Attrs: {region:us-east, rack_affinity:prefer}` and the request id: `req_0a9b3f`.
Arjun (SRE): grabbing control-plane routing logs for req_0a9b3f now. initial observation: route-eval chose pool p-rack-7b with priority score 10 vs p-gold-acme score 8.
James (Eng-runtime): priority score inversion? that sounds like the new affinity-weighting change we pushed yesterday. can you paste the route-eval decision dump?
Arjun (SRE): log excerpt: `route_eval: tenant=acme-prod attrs=[tier:gold, rack_affinity:prefer, capacity_hint:high] candidate_pools=[p-rack-7b(score=10), p-gold-acme(score=8), p-shared-small(score=2)]`. Also found `pool_meta: p-gold-acme.weight_override=null, p-rack-7b.weight=1.2`.
Maria (Support): customer reports throttle started at 09:12, our deploy history shows a controlplane config roll at 08:50 that updated affinity weighting to apply rack_affinity bonus globally.
James (Eng-runtime): ah — the weighting patch accidentally applied as additive to the base policy for all tenants rather than only non-dedicated pools. For tenants with explicit dedicated pools, the rack_affinity bonus can push a smaller rack ahead.
Priya (Customer Success): can we repro quickly in staging with acme tenant config? Customer is breathing down.
James (Eng-runtime): repro steps: `curl -H "X-Tenant: acme-prod" -H "X-Redwood-Tier: gold" -H "X-Route-Attrs: rack_affinity=prefer" https://controlplane/route-decision?req=req_1` then check `GET /internal/route-debug?req=req_1` to see scoring. staging shows same inversion.
Tenant-ops (ACME): is there an immediate mitigation? we need to stop 429s.
Arjun (SRE): temporary mitigation: add explicit tier-pinning on their ingress rule: `route_override: preferred_pool=p-gold-acme` — that will short-circuit scoring. pushing policy now.
Oncall Ops: applied tenant override for acme-prod at 09:34 UTC. customer reports 429s decreased but latency still elevated for a few mins while in-flight requests drain.
Maria (Support): customer says "thanks, much better now" but wants root cause and timeline.
James (Eng-runtime): root cause summary: affinity-weighting diff (PR#823) applied global rack_affinity bonus. scoring function did not clamp bonus relative to pool capacity; small racks could outrank a dedicated gold pool when rack_affinity set. Fix: change scoring to apply affinity bonus only when pool.type != dedicated OR when pool.capacity >= tenant.min_capacity and add an upper clamp. I'm preparing a patch.
James (Eng-runtime): ETA to patch and canary: 45m for build+canary. will push high-priority.
deploy-bot: build 3.14.2 created for PR#832 by @James — queued for canary.
Arjun (SRE): schedule autoscale observation — we saw autoscaler try to scale up p-rack-7b but capped at 2 GPUs due to placement limits; noisy neighbor exacerbated latency. add to RCA: autoscaler cap combined with route inversion caused unintended throttling.
Priya (Customer Success): filing incident summary to ACME (internal) and offering 24/7 support until patch is live.
James (Eng-runtime): canary passed in us-east-1 (10k requests), rolling to prod now.
deploy-bot: deploy 3.14.2 canary -> prod started at 10:12 UTC.
Oncall Ops: monitoring — request routing normalized to p-gold-acme for acme-prod at 10:18 UTC, 429 rate back to baseline.
Maria (Support): thanks all. I'll close the support ticket once customer accepts the postmortem. Please add the following to the postmortem: timeline, config diff (PR#823), mitigation steps (tenant override), permanent fix PR#832, and customer impact metrics.
James (Eng-runtime): will add notes and follow up with a regression test to prevent global application of affinity bonuses.
Tenant-ops (ACME): appreciate the quick response — please share the postmortem and whether there will be compensation.
Priya (Customer Success): will coordinate compensation discussion with bizops.
Maria (Support): closing thread after docs posted. :white_check_mark:
